_what: REGISTRATION of M13's pre-build LoTTE read #1 (ruling R8, Dylan 2026-09-10; m13/RULINGS.md), written while LoTTE is entirely unread for M10/M13. This file is NOT the gate record: m13/LOTTE_GATE.json is written only by the executor that performs the read, and m13src/build13.py must refuse a gate record that lacks an execution outcome.
authority: instructions-m9.md:171 (LoTTE-clean: 7 slices, macro over slices, never pooled)
results/m8_lotte_remedy.json (surviving slices after the E10 remedy and re-screen)

surface.name: LoTTE-clean
surface.macro: equal weight over the seven slices, never pooled
surface.note: instructions-m9.md quotes 20,122 queries before the remedy; the remediated surface carries 14,034.

metric.veto: nDCG@10 (exact search over each slice's remediated collection), macro over slices
metric.descriptive: Success@5, LoTTE's native metric, reported beside the veto metric and attached to no decision
metric.why: every registered bar, contrast and the 0.004 veto margin in this repository are in nDCG@10 units

bootstrap._quantile_method: RULING R17 (Dylan, 2026-09-10), registered BEFORE any LoTTE read: the empirical quantile, numpy method `inverted_cdf`, i.e. order statistic 9,750 of 10,000 draws for the 97.5% upper bound. The repo's registered convention (m9src/final_stats.bootstrap, m10/final_run_registry.json). The 9,751st order statistic (`higher`) can disagree at the margin; pinning the method removes that freedom (Astra review, 2026-09-10).

veto.fires_iff: selected macro is worse than the comparator's by more than 0.004 AND the upper bound is below -0.004
veto.consequence: the comparator's recipe (bs32) is what the 200M build trains; no retraining, no second build

R18_pin.rule: m8src/freeze_lotte.py pin (M8's registered E10-REMEDY PIN, never executed) runs immediately before the gate on the day of the read and its output is committed; the executor compares every slice's five hashes and counts against it and refuses without it. Counts alone authenticate nothing (Astra review, finding 4).

manifest.rule: the second manifest commit of m10/LOTTE_LOCK.md, written by m13src/lotte_gate13.py --write-manifest from the published E arm records after both finished, committed and pushed before the read; the executor requires it tracked, unmodified and agreeing field by field with the live records and bytes; build13.check_gate_manifest binds the gate record to it (Astra review, finding 2).

_amended_2026_09_10.receipt_and_recovery: before the first LoTTE open the executor creates an exclusive receipt under work/lotte/gate13/ binding every input; each slice's outputs are persisted as it completes; a plain re-run refuses while the receipt exists and --recover completes THE SAME read under the identical identity, reading only slices without a persisted output (Astra review, finding 1). This is completion of read #1, not a second read.
_amended_2026_09_10.executor: m13src/lotte_gate13.py (ruling R16); reviews: research/m13-codex-gate-review-2026-09-10.md and the re-review that follows the fixes

required_fields: macro_ndcg10 per slice and overall for candidate and comparator
gate_record_contract.note: a record with executed false or a missing decision must be refused by build13

firewall: LoTTE is not a selection surface, bar, tie-break or C-conjunct input; read #1's only outputs are the veto verdict and the observational row; read #2 is the pre-freeze audit; no third read.
